title: Recording with Georgia White
summary: He recalls accompanying Georgia White with Richard Jones and a bass player on an OK session.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When did you record in Georgia White? Thank you. I recorded with Georgia Blackwood.

I don't know what that was. It seemed to me it was on a, I believe it was an OK record. Yeah, he was A&R director for OK. I think it was an OK record. Yes. Georgia White. Yeah. Georgia White. Georgia White. Georgia, she was singing and Richard was playing the piano and we had a bass fill. I think Lindsey was on bass and I was playing. I think you went with Sammy Stewart or something. You went away and I think that's when I recorded with them.
Yeah, I remember recording with Georgia. Yeah.
